title: Presentation environment on the demo laptop
scope: Make the RSL presentation runnable on the demo laptop: Frappe, Jube and the AI runtime live; Docling, OpenAleph and yente run beforehand with their results recorded and clearly labelled as recorded; one start command, a combined health page, restricted access and up-to-date service status docs

acceptance.text: A demo profile that fits the laptop's memory (live: Frappe, Jube, AI runtime and local model; recorded: Docling, OpenAleph, yente outputs captured from real runs with provenance), one start/stop command, a combined health/status page, loopback-only or authenticated access, and integration/services.json plus docs/SETUP_STATUS.md updated to reality

A rehearsal from a cold start reaches a healthy demo in a measured time without manual fixes; every screen discloses live versus recorded data; memory use is measured and stays within the laptop's limit

Model keys are set only in the demo laptop's ignored .env (Groq org with Zero Data Retention enabled); observed rate limits are recorded; the demo still completes, visibly labelled, on the local or template fallback when offline or rate-limited
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: A rehearsal from a cold start reaches a healthy demo in a measured time without manual fixes; every screen discloses live versus recorded data; memory use is measured and stays within the laptop's limit

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05 after a runtime gap analysis for the RSL demo: the component code existed but this link was not wired at runtime and no task covered it.
